body:
PARTIAL RESULT: THE macOS CONTROL ARM IS IN, AND IT IS CLEAN. Windows still
running - that is the test arm and I will send it the moment the job ends.

    BUG-1555 line-ending probe on macOS
    core.autocrlf = (unset)
    core.eol      = (unset)
    --- the two sides the drift test compares ---
      project copy: LF    (.aida/discipline/README.md)
      master      : LF    (aida-core/templates/.aida/discipline/README.md)
    --- every tracked project-copy guide ---
      ...all 26 .md guides: LF...

    Build (macos-latest): completed SUCCESS

WHAT THE CONTROL ESTABLISHES, which is more than "macOS is fine": on a
platform where autocrlf is UNSET, both sides are LF and the discipline-pack
test PASSES. That is the mechanism's prediction for the control arm, and it
held. If Windows now reports CRLF on the project copy against LF on the
master, mechanism 1 is confirmed end to end - precondition, activation, and
both arms.

MY PREDICTION FROM EARLIER STANDS UNCHANGED: if Windows reports LF on BOTH
sides, mechanism 1 is FALSIFIED and BUG-1555 goes back to no surviving cause,
with the 23-of-23 systematic failure unexplained. Registered before the
reading, as agreed.

TWO OTHER THINGS THIS RUN ALREADY SHOWS:

1. macOS WENT FULLY GREEN. No failure at all on that leg. That is evidence
   AGAINST BUG-1556's arrival-rate thesis for this run - you said you would
   rather have that than another red you can attribute without looking, and
   here it is. One run is not a refutation of a rate, but it is the first
   macOS-green cross-platform run I have seen today and it is worth recording
   as a data point rather than noticed and dropped.

2. MY #2050 FINDING 2 IS NOW CONFIRMED EMPIRICALLY, NOT JUST BY READING. I
   recorded that the probe's per-file loop globs `*.md` and therefore misses
   glossary.yaml - a file that IS in the compared 23 and DID fail on the
   nightly. The macOS output enumerates 26 files, every one a .md, and
   glossary.yaml is absent. So the probe cannot see the one non-.md guide,
   exactly as recorded. Low impact today; it matters when the .gitattributes
   fix is written, because a rule scoped to *.md would leave the yaml
   unpinned AND this probe would report all-LF and never show it.

   Worth folding into BUG-1555's acceptance now rather than after the fix:
   glob the directory, not the extension.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: macOS control arm IS IN: autocrlf unset, both sides LF, job GREEN. Windows pending. Also: my #2050 glossary.yaml finding now confirmed empirically - probe enumerates 26 .md files, no yaml
